artifact.storage_scope: 208 tensors and all 208 ZIP storage payloads are referenced by the model state_dict; no extra image payload or image buffer identified.

relationship.method: Static pickletools opcode analysis into inert symbols followed by SHA-256 comparison of corresponding contiguous float32 tensor byte ranges in ZIP storage and safetensors; no torch.load, pickle.load, GLOBAL import, REDUCE call, training or inference.
relationship.scope: Complete vision encoder only; SAM2 mask decoder and video/object memory are not included in this artifact.

modifications.description_zh: 保留冻结 SAM2 视觉编码器；加入原像素局部分支、多尺度 FPN 投影、ConvGRU 时序状态、语义分类及线/圆/其他辅助预测头，训练项目预测部分；保存编码器架构与状态供离线重建。

training.inputs_zh: 广播原片 RGB、用户确认的位置/轮廓/材质标注和项目审阅标注。此处是既有权重来源事实，不改变今后使用官方50帧单节目源的项目规则。

other_frameworks.RAFT: Referenced by vision_geometry.py as an independent local torchvision flow dependency; ignored models/cache checkpoint is not in the public Git candidate and not embedded in rink_vision.pt.
other_frameworks.PIDNet: Only a framework_sources reference in configs/rink_vision.json in inspected implementation; no PIDNet import or bundled checkpoint identified.
